verdict.rationale: Sentry documents its own SDK as the primary integration path, with Python SDK APIs and integration options such as `set_conversation_id()`, `include_prompts=False` and auto-instrumentation of AI libraries. A community user reports native SDK integration was very simple. missing for 10: evidence of the breadth of officially supported language SDKs beyond Python, and SDK API reference or versioning documentation in the pack.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Drop in the [SDK](https://sentry.io/platforms/). No agents to install.
Use `set_conversation_id()` so every AI span in a chat session shares the same `gen_ai.conversation.id`.
Supported AI libraries are instrumented automatically when their packages are installed.
some SDK integrations set it automatically
